name: Bowels
overview: The Scriptures use the term 'bowels' both literally and figuratively to express deep emotional and physical realities. Joseph's yearning bowels toward his brother in Genesis 43:30 reveal the compassionate and tender sensibilities of the human heart. Conversely, 2 Chronicles 21 describes a grievous physical affliction where King Jehoram suffers from a disease of the bowels that ultimately leads to his death, illustrating the severity of divine judgment. These passages together highlight how 'bowels' signify both the innermost feelings of compassion and the profound physical suffering that can befall a person.
